text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once today's training was finished and I 
was cleaning up with Buena Vista...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah, over there... That's Cesario-chan.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Alright, once more...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Hoo, hoo... Right now! Hyaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Cesario-chan! Great work out there. That 
run just now... was amazing.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Buena-san... you were watching? Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Like the whole atmosphere shifts in 
a single instant... A final stretch drive 
that surges relentlessly toward the 
goal...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, it made me remember 
Special Week-san.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That's—a relief. To tell the truth, I 
tried running with Spe-san in mind just a 
little bit.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... I catch myself doing that 
sometimes too. You just can't help 
daydreaming about running like that, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That Japan Cup where you lived up to 
everyone's expectations... You were truly 
so cool.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That race is truly unforgettable. I 
wonder how many times I've rewatched it by 
now...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah, exactly! ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Cesario-chan. If you'd like, do 
you want to run together after this?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind, but... are you sure? 
Buena-san, aren't you done for the day?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Still... talking about Spe-san made me 
really want to go run.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, how about it? I can still keep 
running."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
If it's with Cesario-chan, who shares the 
same aspirations... I feel like I can 
become even stronger than I am right now!
choice_data_list: Let's run straight toward what we admire!

If you want to get stronger, you need to 
know when to call it a day, too.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—If that's the case, then I'll gladly 
accept.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Let us begin right away, Buena-san. 
Running together... toward even greater 
heights.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! For the sake of my dream... I have 
to surpass who I am today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Buena Vista worked hard on extra 
training together with Cesario.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Time to call it a day... You're right. It 
must be putting quite a strain on your 
body as well...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Then how about tomorrow? I'll make sure to 
get some rest today.
choice_data_list: Got it. I'll adjust the training menu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having made plans for the next training 
session, Buena Vista rested her body.
